## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and are named after the acceptance criteria (a `🧪` commit before the implementation)
- [ ] No test was weakened, skipped or deleted, or the reason is explained above
- [ ] Every new or changed component has a story covering its variants and states
- [ ] Usable with the keyboard and a screen reader; no new axe violation
- [ ] Every new string exists in English and French
- [ ] Docs are updated in this pull request when behavior, architecture, a dependency, a convention or a command
      changes (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/ROADMAP.md`), with an entry
      in `docs/DECISIONS.md` for a major decision
- [ ] A page or layout change was checked in a browser: keyboard, each theme, strict mode, French
- [ ] No secrets or private infrastructure data in code, fixtures or screenshots
